sn48.7:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddhindriyaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti saddhindriyanirodhagāminipaṭipadam nappajānanti || pa [pe] ||
sn48.7:1.5: Paññindriyaṃ nappajānanti paññindriyasamudayaṃ nappajānanti || paññindriyanirodhaṃ nappajānanti paññindriyanirodhagāminipaṭipadam nappajānanti ||
sn48.7:1.6: na me te bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu ceva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā || na ca panete āyasmantā sāmaññatthaṃ vā brahmaññatthaṃ vā diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti || || 4.
sn48.7:2.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saddhindriyam pajānanti saddhindriyasamudayam pajānanti saddhindriyanirodham pajānanti saddhindriyanirodhagāminipaṭipadam pajānanti ||
sn48.7:2.5: paññindriyam pajānanti paññindriyasamudayam pajānanti || paññindriyanirodham pajānanti || paññindriyanirodhagāminipatipadam pajānanti ||
sn48.7:2.6: te kho pana me bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā samaṇesu ceva samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu ca brāhmaṇasammatā || te ca panāyasmanto sāmaññatthaṃ ca brahmaññatthaṃ ca diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī
